newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Acacia says Dec qtr gold output soars.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Acacia says Dec qtr gold output soars.

text.p: Australian gold miner Acacia Resources Ltd on Tuesday reported record quarterly production of 73,920 ounces for the three months to December 31 -- a 54 percent rise on the same 1995 quarter.
The quarterly output took full-year production for calendar 1996 to 267,392 ounces, a 24 percent increase on 1995, but cash costs for 1996 rose 19 percent to A$348 per ounce, Acacia said.
Cash costs were on the way down in the December quarter, falling three percent on the previous quarter to A$355 an ounce, it added.
Gold sales of 271,908 ounces in 1996 netted an average A$564 an ounce, a premium of A$64 an ounce over the spot price, versus 208,067 ounces at A$571 an ounce in 1995, Acacia said.
More than 400,000 ounces of new hedging for production out to the year 2003 was arranged in the fourth quarter and a substantial amount of forecast 1997 production has been hedged.
The company said that as of December 31 the following positions were in place:
Forward sales contracts, deliverable over the period to 2003, totalling 1,043,684 ounces of gold at an average price of A$684 an ounce.
The marked-to-market price of these contracts was A$573 an ounce, representing an unrealised gain of A$114 million.
Short dated call options on 60,000 ounces of gold at an average strike price in 1997 of US$390 an ounce.
Longer-dated call options on 100,000 ounces of gold at a strike price of A$700.

Ore Head Gold Cash Total Mine
Acacia has a 1/3 interest in Boddington, 100 percent of Union Reefs and Brocks Creek and 40 percent of Tanami.
